creator: Sharks, Lee
description: Reproducibility package for a cross-implementation test of deletion semantics: a remember/0.2 producer bundle, an independently built assertion-consistency checker, and a 111-case conformance corpus built before either. Establishes that a recorded removal and a never-landed write are observationally identical at the consumer boundary, and that exposing the absence assertion on a machine-readable discovery surface is necessary and sufficient to separate them.
context: knowledge-catalog#207; fulfils the cross-test offered there
